findings.title: Billing/quota HTTP429 loses its cause and becomes a temporary rate-limit hint
findings.trigger: Documented OpenAI billing/quota condition delivered as SDK APIError.status429; other compatible endpoints conditional on equivalent response
findings.actual: Wrapper drops original message/code/type into generic LLMRateLimitError; actual helper recommends waiting/lowering frequency/switching model rather than fixing quota or billing
findings.expected: Retain and classify billing/quota cause distinctly from transient request throttling
findings.validation: 12focused/25expect actual helper and lightweight exception; provider/SDK/TurnLoop connection source-only
limits: No SDK429 construction or actual wrapper execution
Status-prefixed owned message is a supporting characterization, not proof of SDK message formatting
Static retry branch noted without measured request count or wait duration
